race.comment: INDECISIVE (2) scored over this distance at Wyong two back then nothing went right last start at the same track and trip in a run worth overlooking. Enjoys the run of the race from the inside alley and should be hard to hold out when called upon. HONEY PERFUME (3) scored over 900m at Newcastle two back then turned in last position and made minimal inroads over 1100m at Hawkesbury most recently. Worth another chance dropping back to today's journey. INDEFENSIBLE (8) has won two from two third-up so should improve after a couple of plain efforts in town to launch this campaign. EXFORTYTHREE (7) looks well placed here on resumption and can make an impact.
